Subject: Renewal planning + MAP kickoff

Hi Jonas —

Our current contract with Redwood is up for renewal in July and we want to put a straightforward plan in place. Can we kick off a mutual action plan that covers: updated goals for Year 2, stakeholder roster (we have a couple of new folks), a quick usage review, and any proposed upsell options you recommend?

For context: our core ML infra team will own technical sign-off (Paul S.), and procurement will need a clear pricing path. We’d like a draft MAP by next week if possible so we can align internally before the exec review on 4/21.

Attachments: usage-exports-202703.csv (summary export), current_contract_v2.pdf (we’ll share on request)

Thanks —
Emily

Subject: Re: Renewal planning + MAP kickoff

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the export. I’ve looped in Grace (CS lead), Stephanie (solutions engineer) and Dev (contracts) so we can cover ops, technical validation, and procurement right away.

Proposed MAP outline (we can iterate):
- Week 1 (4/5–4/12): Confirm stakeholders + baseline usage review (deliverable: MAP draft v1 + usage summary)
- Week 2 (4/13–4/19): Technical validation, quantization/batch profile recommendations, and pricing options for committed capacity
- Week 3 (4/20–4/26): Exec review and finalize scope; procurement/contract milestone with draft SOW and SLA exceptions if needed

I attached a starter MAP (MAP-draft-AsterBio-v1.xlsx) with a simple tracker and proposed owners. Quick asks for you: can you confirm the primary business metrics we should optimize for (cost-per-inference, 99th-pct latency, uptime SLA) and the new stakeholder names/roles? Also, are there any data residency or audit requirements for Year 2?

Next steps: Emily, if you can confirm stakeholders and the metrics by 4/8 we’ll have MAP v1 ready and schedule a 30-min sync. Suggested times: 4/9 09:30 or 4/12 14:00 PT.

Best,
Jonas Weber

Thanks all — adding a couple of operational notes from our side:

- Usage: I looked at the March export Emily attached — inference volume is flat MoM but token distribution shows a 27% drop in long-form calls (>1k tokens). That suggests a shift in usage patterns we should discuss (possible cost opportunity with tailored batching/kv cache).
- Stakeholder roster: Emily, can you add a procurement contact (name + email) and the exec sponsor for budget (name + title)?
- SLA ask: AsterBio previously requested lower latency windows for peak hours; if you want to lock that we’ll need an SLA exception which Dev can scope (Dev: including the exception request PDF in the draft contract would help).

Stephanie — can you run a short quantization vs latency sensitivity check on model family we serve for AsterBio and add notes to the MAP? 20–30 minute spike should be enough to propose one or two concrete options.

- Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Renewal planning + MAP kickoff

Appreciate the quick turnaround team — confirming the stakeholder roster below:
- Exec sponsor: Carla Mendes, VP of Product (carla.mendes@asterbio.com)
- Technical lead: Paul Summers (paul.summers@asterbio.com) — cc’d
- Procurement: James O’Neill (james.oneill@asterbio.com)

Goals for Year 2 (short list):
1) Reduce per-inference cost by 18% while maintaining parity in result quality
2) Improve production 95th/99th latency by 15% during peak windows
3) Put in place an audit log retention policy for 24 months (compliance)

We reviewed MAP-draft-AsterBio-v1.xlsx and the outline looks good; we uploaded the current contract and the SLA exception request to the Drive link you shared. Next available for a 30-minute sync: 4/12 14:00 PT works for Paul and me.

Please include a short section in v1 that maps each goal to acceptance criteria and owners — that will smooth the internal exec review.

Emily
Emily Park
Head of Data Platforms | AsterBio
